_meta.name: ValueInvestor framework config
_meta.source: value_investing_framework.pdf (27 pp, synthesized from Graham, Damodaran, McKinsey, Mizrahi, Brealey-Myers-Allen, Bogle)
_meta.rule: Every value below is tagged source=framework (with page) or source=PROPOSED (needs Ming's approval). Tasks must not use PROPOSED values as final until status=approved.

min_avg_daily_dollar_volume_usd.why: framework silent on liquidity; $10M ADV lets a mid-cap position be built/exited in days

profile_in_use.why: conservative (Graham) column passes very few names in 2026 markets; moderate (Buffett) column is framework-sanctioned

dividend_years.why_PROPOSED: would exclude most buyback-only value names; use as a checklist item, not a hard screen

pass_rule.value: must pass all balance-sheet tests (D/E, NetDebt/EBITDA, current ratio) + at least 5 of the remaining valuation/profitability tests
pass_rule.why: framework says thresholds are 'starting points, not absolute rules' (p.8); an all-must-pass rule on 13 tests returns ~0 names

sector_exceptions.financials: skip EV/EBITDA, current ratio, net debt/EBITDA; use P/B vs ROE (p.4) and FCFE/DDM
sector_exceptions.utilities_reits: relax D/E and current ratio (p.6, p.8)

value_trap_check.value: flag if FCF negative while net income positive for 2+ yrs, or ROE+net margin trending down vs industry 3-5 yrs

focus_sectors.rank: high-growth first, finance last, others after

filters.value: balance-sheet tests pass + profitable (NI>0, FCF>0 ex-financials)

growth_list.source: PROPOSED (Ming chose 'growth at a sane price, losses allowed with a path' 2026-10-02; numbers need approval)

data_quality_gates.on_conflict: mark field CONFLICT, show both values, block 'investable' until resolved

multiples.rule: 5-15 peers, use MEDIAN, adjust for growth/leverage

asset_ncav.rule: floor value; NCAV / tangible book / replacement cost

growth_skepticism.value: EPS growth >15% sustained beyond 5-10 yrs must be justified explicitly

range_output.low: min of method bases after sensitivity (bear)

extra_mos_rule.value: +10pts if any single risk could permanently impair a large part of value

rules.BUY: MoS >= required AND moat strong AND catalyst within 1-2 yrs AND risks manageable AND conviction >= 70
rules.WATCH: MoS within 10pts of required, OR a BUY-quality business with no dated catalyst (p.21), OR conviction 50-69
rules.PASS: MoS insufficient/negative with weak business, OR any red-flag risk that could permanently impair value, OR conviction < 50

moat_durability.evidence: ROE & net margin vs industry 5yr trend (p.10), moat type (p.10)

financial_strength.evidence: D/E, NetDebt/EBITDA, interest cover, FCF vs NI (p.6-7, p.22)

management_capital_alloc.evidence: insider %, buyback timing, M&A record, comp design (p.10, p.13)

valuation_mos.evidence: MoS vs required; agreement between methods (p.19-20)

conviction_score.each_component: scored 0-5 with a one-line reason + source; score = sum(weight x s/5)

items.test: P/E 3yr, P/B, P/E x P/B, EV/EBITDA within profile
D/E, NetDebt/EBITDA, current ratio, interest cover >= 3x
FCF positive & growing; FCF >= ~NI over 5 yrs
Identified moat type with durability evidence
Aligned incentives, sensible buybacks, no restatements
Value not dependent on terminal growth / peak margins

position_sizing_note.value: framework: conviction x MoS weighted, max 5-10% at cost, 10-30 names (p.22). Shown as a reference line only, not a recommendation.

health.GREEN: no open issues or only info
health.RED: >=1 high issue or any kill criterion hit

monitoring.issue_rules_source: Ming 2026-09-28 (pillar KPI breach, kill criterion, earnings miss/guide cut/revisions, mgmt/cap alloc/dilution/leverage, price vs value band, missed catalyst, stale)

estimate_revision_material.value: NTM EPS consensus moves >= 5% in 30 days

monitoring.kill_criteria_rule: 3-5 per thesis, at least 2 machine-checkable (metric_key/threshold/direction); price alone never a kill criterion (Ming 2026-10-02)

data_sources._rule: Free sources only (Ming 2026-09-29). Every figure: {value, source, as_of}. Cross-check price and market cap against >=2 sources; on mismatch beyond gates mark CONFLICT.

priority.source: SEC EDGAR XBRL API (data.sec.gov companyfacts / submissions / frames)
priority.use: reported financials, shares outstanding, 10-K/10-Q/8-K text, Form 4 insider trades, 13F
priority.notes: requires User-Agent header with contact email; 10 req/s limit

priority.use: price, market cap, volume/ADV, consensus estimates & revisions, analyst targets, beta
priority.notes: unofficial; cross-check price vs a 2nd source

priority.use: equity risk premium, industry betas, industry average margins/multiples for peer context
long history sanity checks, screener pre-filter only

priority.source: Web news search (Reuters, CNBC, company PRs)

gaps_to_flag: consensus estimates only from Yahoo (single source) -> tag confidence=Medium
no point-in-time estimate history -> revisions computed from our own weekly snapshots
